title: Society Guidelines v1.0 adopted
summary: The consolidated guidelines document was approved and circulated to all owners and tenants for sign-off.

title: Penalty schedule for guideline violations
summary: A consolidated schedule of fines was approved, to be applied uniformly across all blocks.

title: Quarterly maintenance due on the 15th
summary: Maintenance is payable quarterly through NoBrokerhood, with a 2% per month penalty on overdue balances.

title: Swimming pool closed on Mondays
summary: Weekly cleaning and water treatment scheduled for Mondays; normal timings resume Tuesday.

title: Vehicle registration for Gate 2 access
summary: All resident vehicles must be registered with the society office for boom barrier access at Gate 2.

title: Housekeeping and security agency appointment
summary: Appointment of the housekeeping and security agencies for the following financial year was ratified.

title: Clubhouse and guest room booking rules
summary: Bookings are first-come, first-served through the Maintenance Manager, with charges as per the fee schedule.

title: Festival celebrations and volunteer participation
summary: Celebrations remain optional and subject to resident participation, volunteer availability and committee approval.
